# Stage 01-validate: Validate

[← 00-idea](./00-idea.md) · [all stages](./README.md) · [02-foundation →](./02-foundation.md)

**Purpose.** Test demand, market, pricing and economics with real evidence before spending money.

**Exit gate.** Go / adjust / stop decided against criteria written down before the research or interviews started.
